scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter @lemnaria/configurator-domain run build && pnpm --filter @lemnaria/three-adapter run build && pnpm --filter @lemnaria/persistence run build
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:deps && next typegen && eslint . --max-warnings 0
